name: Whereby
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Whereby, host one simple browser meeting room using a self-managed WebRTC stack. The hard boundary is browser media reliability, turn capacity, recording, embeds, and support, plus real-time media infrastructure and reliability.
